base.--cds-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 var(--cds-shadow-color)
base.--cds-shadow-md: 0 2px 4px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 7%), 0 6px 16px 0 var(--cds-shadow-color)
base.--cds-shadow-lg: 0 4px 8px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 8%), 0 12px 28px -2px var(--cds-shadow-color)
base.--cds-shadow-drop-glow: inset 0 0 24px -2px hsl(from var(--cds-fill-accent) h s l / 20%)
base.--cds-shadow-drop-glow-danger: inset 0 0 24px -2px hsl(from var(--cds-fill-danger) h s l / 20%)
base.--cds-font-mono: var(--cds-font-mono-override,) var(--font-anthropic-mono,"SF Mono"), "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
base.--cds-font-mono-ui: var(--font-anthropic-mono,"SF Mono"), "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
base.--cds-font-voice: var(--font-anthropic-serif,ui-serif), ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

root.--cds-shadow-drop-glow: inset 0 0 24px -2px hsl(from var(--cds-role-accent-fill) h s l / 20%)
root.--cds-shadow-drop-glow-danger: inset 0 0 24px -2px hsl(from var(--cds-role-danger-fill) h s l / 20%)
root.--cds-font-mono: var(--cds-font-mono-override,) ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
root.--cds-font-mono-ui: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
root.--cds-font-system: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "PingFang TC", "Hiragino Sans", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif
